note: The task kinds of docs/plans/phase-6-administration.md, section Task Kinds, each with its treatment (leg 6-kinds, rulings KN1 to KN4). types are the rows with a type id: the four ids of the content fixture (testdata/export/fixture-content/qrtz_job_details.jsonl) and the ids of this server, marked own; a built type carries its fields in the shape of the task type list of the contract. classes are the kinds without a known id, with the number of kinds of the capture each holds; their ids are an owner point. A stored task of a type not listed here stays disabled as not known. internal/tasks holds a Go copy, and a test fails when the two differ.
